# ibee_cdn_website (Resource)

Static website/SPA configuration on an existing bucket-backed CDN distribution. The index object must already exist. Destroy disables website routing without deleting objects or the distribution. Import using the distribution ID.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ibee_cdn_website" "app" {
  distribution_id = "DISTRIBUTION_ID"
  index_document  = "index.html"
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `distribution_id` | `string` | Required |  |
| `enabled` | `bool` | Read-only |  |
| `id` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `index_document` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted |  |

## Import

Import an existing resource with the identifier shown. Review the imported plan before applying; creation-only settings and local deletion permissions cannot always be reconstructed from the API.

```shell
terraform import ibee_cdn_website.app 'DISTRIBUTION_ID'
```
